title: Langry RH225-A Mechanical Rebound Hammer: Specifications, Uses & Testing Guide
author: Accurion Technical Team
excerpt: Comprehensive technical guide for the Langry RH225-A concrete test hammer. Explore impact energy specs, calibration on test anvils, IS 13311-2 testing procedure, and maintenance tips.
body: The **Langry RH225-A Mechanical Concrete Test Hammer** is the civil engineering industry standard for rapid, non-destructive evaluation of concrete compressive strength. Conforming strictly to **IS 13311 (Part 2)**, **ASTM C805**, and **EN 12504-2**, it provides engineers and site inspectors with immediate rebound number readings across normal structural concrete.
seo_description: Comprehensive guide on Langry RH225-A mechanical rebound hammer. Covers technical specifications, IS 13311-2 test methods, calibration on steel anvils, and maintenance tips.
